top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 244 RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 14 were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found no new requests for additional information, no new Form 99 correspondence, no voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more, and no red-flag keyword hits in this window.
The only item from the automated extras is in Deadline Watch: the campaign of Rep. Emanuel Cleaver (D-MO-5) filed its October Quarterly (Q3) report on 10/16/2026, one day late.
